ideas.idea: Give each page its own title and description via useHead (e.g. guides.vue)
ideas.why: This is the known shared-title problem restated, but the per-page fix is accurate; it duplicates a known problem so it is only weakly additive.

ideas.idea: Set site URL in Nuxt config (site.url) so canonicals and sitemap URLs derive from it
ideas.why: No origin is declared anywhere and the sitemap uses a placeholder domain, so declaring it is a concrete, repo-specific fix.

ideas.idea: Add an absolute canonical link per page
ideas.why: No canonical is set anywhere in the repo, and adding one is a concrete action that helps search engines pick the right URL.

ideas.idea: Replace placeholder domain trailhead.example in sitemap with the real origin
ideas.why: The sitemap really lists trailhead.example URLs, which would point crawlers at the wrong domain.

ideas.idea: Resolve sitemap listing the noindex /guides page (remove header or drop URL)
ideas.why: This is the same noindex-on-/guides problem already listed as known.

ideas.idea: Fill out thin guides page with actual route listings, one page per route
ideas.why: guides.vue only has a heading and one sentence promising routes that are not listed, so real content would help people and machines.

ideas.idea: Add a short intro and links to featured walks on the home page
ideas.why: index.vue contains only an h1 and a button, so intro text and real links give crawlers and readers more to understand and follow.

ideas.why: The sitemap is hand-kept, but with two routes the benefit is small and the advice applies to any Nuxt site.
